items.sentence: On [MASK], July 3, 2018, and July 16, 2018, Complainant’s first-level supervisor (S1), Force Development Flight Chief, GS-0301-13, claimed to have given a verbal counseling to Complainant; however, no documentation was generated in Complainant’s personnel file; 2.
On [MASK], Complainant was given a Letter of Reprimand by S1; 3.
On [MASK], March 14, 2019, March 21, 2019, April 2, 2019, and April 3, 2019, S1 accepted incorrect statements from Complainant’s subordinates; 4.
On [MASK], Complainant was given a Notice of Proposed Removal letter, signed by S1; 5.
On or about [MASK], Complainant was mailed a Decision to Remove letter dated June 28, 2019, signed by S1; and 6.
